card.name: Lab threshold numbers before mg/dL
card.fires_on: The first digit of a lab cutoff value (such as 2 in 200 or 240 mg/dL) in cholesterol and triglyceride shift tables. It also fires on a few linking words or units right before laboratory-test terms.

modes.label: Cutoff digit
modes.description: The leading digit of a lipid threshold written as ≥ or < a number before mg/dL.

modes.label: Before lab tests
modes.description: A linking word or unit right before a mention of laboratory tests or cell counts.
